title: 6.8 Piecewise Functions

icans: I can graph and write piecewise functions.
I can write step functions and absolute value functions as piecewise functions.

vocab: a function defined by two or more ____________, each for a different part of the domain
a ____________ function whose pieces are constant, so the graph looks like stairs
the ___________ is not included / is included

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Piecewise function: A piecewise function uses different _______________ on different parts of the _______________.
Evaluating: To evaluate, first find which piece’s _______________ the input fits.

blocks.stem:
Let f(x) = 2x + 1 if x ≤ 1, and f(x) = x² − 3 if x > 1.
Find f(−2), f(1), and f(3).
Graph f(x) = x + 3 if x < 1, and f(x) = −2x + 1 if x ≥ 1.

notes: Step function: A step function has pieces that are all _______________.

blocks.stem: A parking garage charges $5 for the first hour or part of an hour and $3 for each additional hour or part of an hour, up to 3 hours. Write a step function for the cost. How much is 2.5 hours?

Let f(x) = −x if x < −1;  4 if −1 ≤ x ≤ 2;  x² if x > 2.
Find f(−3), f(2), and f(5).

tickets.stem: Let f(x) = 3x − 2 if x < 2, and f(x) = 5 − x if x ≥ 2. Find f(2).
Use the same f. Find f(0).
